checks: Ordinary non-elevated uid and interactive stdin required for action modes; read-only check/inspect do not require TTY.
Both independent false production flags reject action modes before preparation read, Host construction or capture.

Exact bounded owned canonical preparation/head bytes, SHA256, fixed transaction root, uid, fixed loaded module origins, full local runtime helper hashes and exact pinned framework interpreter family are enforced.
Fresh refuses any retained root; raw admission precedes capture; original preparation is reread before and after capture; one Controller.run call uses its existing shared execution lock.
Resume requires exact four history hashes, retained Host attachment without capture, unchanged preparation, one resume_one call and the existing authoritative under-lock reconstruction.
Preflight delegates to the exact fixed-origin final fixture reader; legacy fixture fields no longer supply acceptance; normalized interpreter and host proof remain mandatory.
No retry, cleanup, rollback, arbitrary target, arbitrary command or privilege elevation was added. Exceptions retain effects and records.

test_review.source_only: Tests use temporary JSON records and mocked Host/OS boundaries. They cover disabled/no-capture, uid/TTY, exact record hash/type/path, stale/fresh root, preparation drift, one-step dispatch and preserved capture errors.
test_review.nonblocking_gap: Dispatch tests mock source_and_interpreter; focused fake tests of that new function (wrong loaded origin, omitted helper, interpreter family/hash drift) would strengthen final enabled-release qualification.

limits: This review does not enable flags or accept the actual OS recovery fixture, ProductionHost transaction, stopped live restore or maintenance duration.
Partial capture may leave an incomplete transaction before controller journal creation; it remains an explicit operator-review stop with no automatic capture replay.
Subsequent helper-closure additions or source changes require a new exact-source checkpoint/review delta.
